## Release impact

<!-- See "Compatibility contract" in AGENTS.md. -->

- [ ] Patch: bug fix, docs, tooling, or internal change with no API change
- [ ] Minor: new optional prop, export or feature
- [ ] Major: removes or changes existing props, defaults, exports or peer range

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally
- [ ] Added or updated tests in `src/__tests__/`
- [ ] Rebuilt and committed `dist/` (only if `src/` changed)
- [ ] Added an entry to `CHANGELOG.md` under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] Updated `README.md` if usage or props changed
